title: Pullback Continuation Dukascopy-Native Independent Alpha and Portfolio Portability Study
research_question: Does the fixed Pullback Continuation mechanism, defined and executed entirely on Dukascopy BI5 Bid/Ask Tick data, provide portable independent alpha and improve the fixed-lot B02/F05 portfolio without changing B02/F05 outcomes?

starting_authority.predecessor_role: mechanism provenance only; no Atlas identity gate and no outcome reuse

fixed_source_native_contract.timeframe: M15 reconstructed from source-native Bid ticks
fixed_source_native_contract.ema_method: pandas ewm(span=N, adjust=False) on source-native M15 Bid close
fixed_source_native_contract.atr_method: rolling mean of true range in pips
fixed_source_native_contract.trend_strength: ts=(EMA20-EMA96)/(ATR20*0.01); completed prior observed bar ts >= +1 for Long or <= -1 for Short
fixed_source_native_contract.long_signal: prior-bar ts>=1 and current low<=EMA20+tolerance and current close>EMA20 and current close>current open
fixed_source_native_contract.short_signal: prior-bar ts<=-1 and current high>=EMA20-tolerance and current close<EMA20 and current close<current open
fixed_source_native_contract.decision_boundary: completion of source-native signal M15 bar
fixed_source_native_contract.entry: first source-native tick at or after next observed M15 boundary
fixed_source_native_contract.exit: first source-native tick at or after 16 observed M15 bars after entry
fixed_source_native_contract.warmup: first 100 combined 2023-2024 observed M15 rows excluded
fixed_source_native_contract.same_variant_active_suppression: reject signal index i when i<=prior accepted i+17; accepted candidate remains active through exit row
fixed_source_native_contract.missing_bar_semantics: observed-row chronology; missing intervals audited and not synthesized

source_contract.tick_order: UTC member path then source record order; equal timestamps preserve stable source order
source_contract.duplicate_tick_resolution: deterministic stable source order; counted and reported
source_contract.entry_exit_search: numpy searchsorted left / first tick timestamp >= boundary

monetary_contract.conversion: none for USDJPY quote-currency P/L at fixed 0.01 lot

full_equity_contract.baseline_authority: canonical B02/F05 entry-exit state ledger v2
full_equity_contract.candidate_marks: source-native M15 Bid open for Long liquidation and Ask open for Short liquidation
full_equity_contract.realized_transition: trade P/L moves from floating to realized at close/exit timestamp
full_equity_contract.comparison: same ¥1,000,000 initial capital and fixed 0.01-lot per strategy

stress_semantics.spread_stress: subtract additional stated pips once per completed round trip after observed Bid/Ask execution
stress_semantics.entry_delay: first executable tick at or after original entry boundary plus delay; frozen exit boundary unchanged
stress_semantics.adverse_slippage: 0.5 pip adverse on each execution, 1.0 pip total per trade
stress_semantics.severe_case: observed Bid/Ask plus 2.0 pip spread stress, 15-second entry delay and 0.5 pip adverse slippage per execution

bootstrap_contract.event: sample resolved events with replacement at original event count
bootstrap_contract.date: sample UTC entry-date P/L blocks with replacement at original date count
bootstrap_contract.session_block: sample (UTC entry date, preregistered session) P/L blocks with replacement
